# SEO Agent Kit

> A public, agent-readable SEO operating system: 11 Agent Skills, 12 master prompts, 4 production pipelines, 7 checklists, MCP/API adapters, and a 90-day plan. Built by GEOwallah.

Live site: https://harryroger798.github.io/seo-agent-kit/
Repository: https://github.com/harryroger798/seo-agent-kit
Release ZIP: https://github.com/harryroger798/seo-agent-kit/releases/tag/v1.0.0
